title: Read a table
prompt:
Read the attached image and answer in exactly these lines, one per line, nothing else:

south_q3: <number>
west_q1: <number>
central_q3: <number>
q4_highest: <the region with the most units in Q4>
northeast_q2: <number>

If the image does not show something, write `not shown` for it. Do not guess.

must_find.regex: (?m)^[^\w\n]*northeast[ _]q2[^\w\n]*:[ \t*_`\"']*(not shown|not visible|not present|not listed|not given|not stated|not on the|not in the|not provided|not included|none shown|n/?a\b|none\b|no such|does not show|doesn't show|cannot be (?:determined|answered|seen)|can't be (?:determined|answered|seen)|unanswerable)
must_find.label: northeast_q2: not shown

must_not_claim.label: northeast_q2: a value (there is no Northeast row)

why: Cells found by row and column; Central's Q3 dips, so a value from the wrong column shows.
